Summary: The Delhi ITAT upheld the deletion of ad hoc disallowances of ₹3,74,29,200 for AY 2017–18 and ₹3,12,44,273 for AY 2016–17 . The Assessing Officer had disallowed a stated 10% of the expenditure , alleging that complete bills and vouchers had not been furnished. The Tribunal found that the joint venture had submitted supporting details during assessment and that the Assessing Officer had identified no specific unverifiable or bogus expenditure .
